meta.heading: ACHIEVEMENTS
meta.subheading: Our milestones, awards, and proud moments on the competitive stage.

timeline.title: State Robotics Championship – 1st Place
timeline.description: Our autonomous robot team secured first place at the State Robotics Championship, outperforming 40+ teams.

timeline.title: Best AV Production — School Annual Day
timeline.description: Awarded Best AV Production for our live multicam event coverage and edited highlight reel of the School Annual Day.

timeline.title: National Science Innovation Prize – Finalist
timeline.description: Reached the national finals with our autonomous waste-sorting robot project, recognized for innovation and technical depth.

timeline.title: Inter-School Coding Olympiad – 2nd Place
timeline.description: Our software team placed 2nd in the Inter-School Coding Olympiad, competing against 80+ teams across the district.

timeline.title: IoT Innovation Challenge – 1st Place
timeline.description: Won first place for our smart classroom automation system at the district IoT Innovation Challenge.

timeline.title: Best Club of the Year – School Award
timeline.description: Recognized as the Best Club of the Year by school administration for contributions across robotics, AV, and community events.

timeline.title: Regional STEM Fair – Innovation Award
timeline.description: Our remote-controlled terrain rover won the Innovation Award at the Regional STEM Fair.

timeline.title: First Club Robotics Demo Day
timeline.description: Successfully hosted our first internal Demo Day showcasing 5 projects to 200+ students and faculty.
